verdict.rationale: Cactus's on-device models run with 'no data leaving the device', and LoRA fine-tuning can be done locally with your own data and hardware. Both indirectly keep user data out of anyone else's training, but there is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out control. The hosted platform takes uploaded data and cloud routing sends hard queries off-device, and neither has a stated data-use policy. Missing for 10: an explicit policy that customer data is not used for model training, an opt-out control for hosted fine-tuning and cloud routing, documented data-retention terms, and independent corroboration.
